LESSON: TRADE AND FINANCE IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relationship)
Topic 6.2: Trade and Finance in Islam
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Trade and Finance in Islam, part of Muamalat (Social Relationship) in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do Muslims spend their income? 2. Why should Muslims spend their income in a halal manner?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use digital devices or Islamic books to search for halal and haram sources of earning and make class presentations,

2. discuss legitimate ways of spending income and share in class

3. brainstorm the effects of spending income in haram and present in class,

4. discuss the importance of lawful earnings and make notes,

5. role play on the benefits of spending income in legitimate ways,

6. search and watch video clips on legitimate ways of spending and make notes. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use digital devices or Islamic books to search for halal and haram sources of earning and make class presentations,
2. discuss legitimate ways of spending income and share in class
3. brainstorm the effects of spending income in haram and present in class,
4. discuss the importance of lawful earnings and make notes,
5. role play on the benefits of spending income in legitimate ways,
6. search and watch video clips on legitimate ways of spending and make notes. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Trade and Finance in Islam together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: enhanced as learners share in class on legitimate ways of spending income.

• Digital Literacy Skills: the learners interact with digital devices when searching for information on legitimate sources of

earning and making class presentations.

• Communication and Collaboration: the learners listen, appreciate and respect the opinions of others when discussing in

groups the importance of lawful earnings.

Values:
Integrity: enhanced through discussions on the importance of lawful earnings.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Integrity: enhanced as learners role play on the benefits of spending income in legitimate ways.

Link to other subjects:

Pre-Technical Studies: as learners use digital devices to search for halal and haram sources of earning.
